description: This file defines the LoggerLog class, which provides internal logging functionalities for the log4php framework, including methods for debug, error, and warning logging using PHP's trigger_error.

classes.name: LoggerLog
classes.description: Helper class for internal logging within the log4php framework, offering static methods for debug, error, and warning messages.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified error level if internal debugging is enabled.

methods.name: internalDebugging
methods.description: Enables or checks the internal debugging state; returns whether debugging is active.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Convenience method to log debug messages.
